question: In which of the following years, did Mahatma Gandhi propose the Wardha Scheme of Basic Education?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1937.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In **1937__**, __**Mahatma Gandh**__i proposed the __**Wardha Scheme of Basic Education.**__

 __
 
• The **Wardha Education **Plan was the name given to it.
 
• It was intended that all children between the ages of **8 and 14 **should have access to **free**, **public education **in their **native tongues**.
 
• **Nai Talim,** or the **New Education**, became the name for this. 
 
• The purpose of fundamental education was to foster the **virtues **of the **ideal citizen**, and greater emphasis should be placed on **Indian culture **than **literacy**.
 
• **English **should have no room in the **curriculum**.
 
• In this plan, **religious instruction **has **no place.**
 
• The most crucial aspect was the economic objectives of the fundamental education, which would be developed over the course of **seven years **by the **kids**' **manual labour**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• On **October 22 **and **23**, **1937**, the **Wardha Education Conference **took place, and the following three **fundamental resolutions **were adopted:

 
 
• 7 years of the **nationwide**, **free **and **required education.**
 
• **Mother Tongue **shall be the **Instructional Medium.**
 
• Not only for **degrees **and **exams** but also for **physical **or **productive employment**, education will be **prioritised**. As a result, it combined **craft work**, **social environment**, and **physical environment**.
 
 
 
• A **committee **led by **Dr Zakir Hussain** was constituted as a result of this conference in **Wardha**.
 
• The **Wardha Scheme of Basic Education**, which the **Committee **submitted as part of its report in **March 1938**, was the **first comprehensive national basic education programme.**
